problems.problem: The previous coved cyclorama sweep (visible in the last version arcing at y≈700-780 behind the shoulder) is gone: the wall now reads as one continuous matte mineral plane with a soft radial brightening centered behind the hero, which matches the monument concept. However the render still resolves the lower fifth of the frame (y≈1225-1440) as a separate lighter concrete floor deck with a straight horizontal wall/floor junction running full width. The bottle base (y=1311) correctly stands in front of that junction on the deck, so contact is not compromised, but the declared concept is a monolithic wall void with 'no corner and no floor sweep'; the visible deck edge re-introduces a photographed room corner and softens the monumental void read.

Contact detail crop [259,1171,821,1421] confirms a genuine contact shadow at offset_y 0 (correct, do not move): a dark occlusion core sits flush under the base, visibly denser and wider than the previous pale smudge, now reaching roughly 75-80% of the 402 px footprint. It still pinches out just short of the two base corners, and the deck immediately in front of the base stays uniformly light with no faint forward penumbra, so under the declared broad soft frontal light the monument still rests a touch lightly at its corners.

References 3-5 all let the environment react to and wrap the hero (Diptyque's reflected ceiling glow in the glass, Hermès's atmospheric dust around the silhouette, Prada's matched studio wrap). Here the wall's radial glow behind the hero is present, but the dark glass edges still carry warm specular highlights that ignore the cool #9aa0a4 ambient, and the wall shows no局部 luminance reaction (no subtle darkening or bounce) adjacent to the silhouette, so the bottle keeps a slight clean-cut-out read against the plane; this remains the largest gap to campaign-grade integration.

Hierarchy and alignment are disciplined (logo 26 / title 72 / subtitle 24 in one tight left block, text_product_overlap all false, no collision with the bottle at x≥339), but the brief's accent rule under the subtitle renders as a near-black hairline and the declared palette accent #b0762a appears nowhere in the typographic block; the promised three-color monument grid (cool grey / ink / copper) executes as two colors, leaving the type block visually disconnected from the warm gold label it should echo.

changes.value: Monolithic flat raw cast concrete wall in cool grey, perfectly continuous matte mineral surface extending edge to edge with no seams, no joints, no corner, no horizon and no floor deck, very subtle broad radial luminance falloff softly brighter behind the center of the plane and faintly cooling toward the edges, even diffuse frontal illumination with cool ambient wrap that gently grazes any standing object, empty architectural void
